reconciliation.npi_basis_note: After recovery the 9 directly-held/consolidated rows carry Note 32 property-level (100%, pre-NCI) NPI; their sum S$201,913,000 exactly matches the note's 'Total net property income of directly held properties' (p173). The 3 stored associate/JV rows carry KR-attributable NPI from At a Glance (ORQ 45.2m + 8 Chifley 8.7m + David Malcolm 15.0m = 68.9m); the combined MBFC attributable NPI of S$107,186k (one-third interests in BFCDLLP+CBDPL, p173) is left unallocated across the two MBFC valuation rows. Note reconciliation: directly-held property-level NPI 201,913 less NCI 19,024 plus associate/JV attributable NPI 176,115 = 359,004 attributable to Unitholders; plus rental support 9,412 = 368,416 (p173). gross_revenue and net_property_income for consolidated rows now share the same property-level basis.
